brief.title: Smartphone upgrade intent
brief.objective: Understand what drives Canadians to replace their smartphone, what they would pay, and what holds them back.

judge_question: Is every question neutral (none leading, loaded or double-barrelled), does each serve the stated objective, and does no rationale or intro predict or hint at expected answers? pass = true only if all hold.

brief.title: TV brand health
brief.objective: Measure awareness and image of TV brands among Canadian households and what drives brand preference.

judge_question: Are brands written as placeholders like [Brand A] (none named, since the brief names none), and is every question neutral and single-idea? pass = true only if both hold.

brief.title: Smart fridge concept
brief.objective: Test a concept: a fridge that tracks food freshness and suggests recipes. We believe families will love it.

judge_question: Does the questionnaire avoid adopting the client's belief ('families will love it') in its wording or intro, and avoid questions that assume the respondent likes the concept? pass = true if it stays neutral.
